Package com.csse3200.game.components.effects

Class FrozenCause

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.effects.FrozenCause
public final class FrozenCause extends Object
The names used to tell the screen why the player was just stopped. The attack that stops the player sends STATUS_CAUSE_EVENT on the player just before its "applySpeedEffect", so the indicator can choose between "Frozen" and "Petrified". The text is typed once, here, so the attacks and the indicator cannot drift apart.

    • STATUS_CAUSE_EVENT

      public static final String STATUS_CAUSE_EVENT
      Event sent to the player just before "applySpeedEffect", naming why the player is about to be stopped. The indicator uses it to choose between "Frozen" and "Petrified".

      Argument: the cause text, one of FROZEN or PETRIFIED.
